privacy: The supplied auth token and signed playback URLs are excluded. Private responses stay outside the repository.
limits: Origins from stream request headers may be referrers/CDNs/download hops, not provider websites. Manifest lists names and filters without upstream API URLs. Stream metadata was sampled for Inception and Cowboy Bebop; no media was downloaded or speed/playback verified.
